body:
This PR replaces the placeholder snow optics (which previously reused the `LookUpCld` clamped cloud-ice table) with standalone band-averaged precipitation lookup tables (`LookUpPrecip`) generated following Feng, Menzel, & Paynter (2025, *JAMES*, doi:10.1029/2024MS004478) and Yang et al. (2013).

### Changes

  - Adds the precipitation artifact and the script that generates it (`Artifacts.toml`, `src/ArtifactPaths.jl`, `scripts/generate_rrtmgp_precip_lut.jl`). The `rrtmgp-precip-optics-data` artifact contains `rrtmgp-precip-lw-bnd.nc` and `rrtmgp-precip-sw-bnd.nc`, leaving the upstream `rrtmgp-data` cloud tables untouched.
  - Tabulates $N = 64$ log-uniform effective radii across the 16 LW and 14 SW RRTMGP bands (Planck thin-averaging in LW, solar thick-averaging in SW) for:
    - **Snow ($5\text{–}1100\,\mu\mathrm{m}$):** Yang et al. (2013) severely roughened `solid_column` (`Rough050`), Gamma PSD $a = 1$, $T_\mathrm{LW} = 233\,\mathrm{K}$.
    - **Rain ($5\text{–}5000\,\mu\mathrm{m}$):** Wiscombe Mie scattering + Segelstein (1981) refractive index, Gamma PSD $a = 1$, $T_\mathrm{LW} = 250\,\mathrm{K}$ (included in the artifact for future support; not yet wired into `CloudState`).
  - Adds `LookUpPrecip` (with CPU-scalar size counts for GPU scalar-indexing safety) and $O(1)$ log-uniform interpolation via `compute_lookup_precip_props`.
  - Wires snow optics through `LookupBundle`, 1-scalar LW, and 2-stream LW/SW (including fused clear+all-sky) paths on both CPU and CUDA.
  - Compiles out `LookUpPrecip` completely when `cld_path_sno === nothing` (`include_snow = false`), preserving zero-overhead performance and bitwise-identical fluxes in snow-off runs.
  - Documents the precipitation optics formulation, current scope (rain not yet active; snow gated by `cloud_fraction` via `cld_mask`), and 1D/2D lookup-table visualizations reproducing Figures 4 & 6 of Feng et al. (2025).
  - Adds unit tests for `compute_lookup_precip_props`, CPU/GPU lookup serialization, TOA LW/SW snow radiative response, `JET.@test_opt`, and zero allocations (`@allocated == 0`).
title: Add snow to lookup tables
